content:
I am declaring:

macro_rules
  | `(tactic| get_elem_tactic_extensible) => `(tactic| my_awesome_tactic)

When declaring a new macro, it is added to the list of possible elaborations for the matching syntax, however it is added to the start, which means it is tried first! I need my tactic to be tried last. Is there a way to do this?

I tried to declare a macro with a lower priority (via macro (priority := low)) but, if I understand correctly, the priority is for a new syntax which means my tactic isn't tried at all.

Any help would be very appreciated!
I'm not aware of a way to change the order, but why do you want to your tactic to run last? Is it for performance reasons?
The reason is that I’m writing a tactic that modifies some global state, and it shouldn’t be used if another way to prove membership would work.
